name: The Lost Land Of Bahía Blanca
source:
Play as an elderly woman with a dark past, and a criminal background to match. Choose your unlawful skills and set out to find your missing family amidst a vampire dictatorship run by the Blood Junta.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144100/The_Lost_Land_Of_Bahia_Blanca/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演一位背负着灰暗过往、同时有着与之相称的犯罪前科的老妇人。挑选你的非法技能，在由“鲜血军政府”统治的吸血鬼独裁政权之下，踏上寻找失踪家人的旅途。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144100/The_Lost_Land_Of_Bahia_Blanca/]Steam[/url]]
